related.title: 工業壓縮機系統整合
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：效率分母清楚，揚程是總能量差，功率流向閉合且保留量測誤差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Denominators are explicit, head is total energy difference, and the power ledger closes with measurement uncertainty.
related.difference: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
related.differenceEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 水力功率ρgQH；泵效率除軸功率，泵組效率除電力，兩者分母不同。 合成水ρ1000 kg/m³，Q0.020 m³/s，H20 m，軸功率5.0 kW，電力5.5 kW。 Ph=1000×9.81×0.020×20=3924 W；泵η78.48%，泵組η71.345%。
若用實測平均比能耗e，洩漏能量E=q_leak te；此估算忽略卸載控制造成的非線性。 合成洩漏0.30 m³/min、運行4000 h/年、平均比能耗0.11 kWh/m³，三者使用同一自由空氣基準。 漏氣體積0.30×60×4000=72000 m³/年；耗能7920 kWh/年。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Hydraulic power is ρ gQH; pump efficiency divides by shaft power, pump-set efficiency by electrical input. Synthetic water ρ1000 kg/m³, Q 0.020 m³/s, H 20 m, shaft 5.0 kW, electrical 5.5 kW. Ph=3924 W; pump η78.48%, pump-set η71.345%.

With measured average specific energy e, leak energy E=q_leak te; the estimate omits unloading-control nonlinearities. Synthetic leak 0.30 m³/min,4000 h/year, specific energy 0.11 k Wh/m³, all on one free-air reference basis. Leak volume=72000 m³/year; estimated energy 7920 k Wh/year.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 柔性夾爪與軟體機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：效率分母清楚，揚程是總能量差，功率流向閉合且保留量測誤差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Denominators are explicit, head is total energy difference, and the power ledger closes with measurement uncertainty.
related.difference: 比較幾何尺寸對柔順度的影響，辨認小變形梁與大變形軟體機器人的差距。
related.differenceEn: Compare geometric effects on compliance and distinguish small-deflection beams from large-deformation soft robots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 水力功率ρgQH；泵效率除軸功率，泵組效率除電力，兩者分母不同。 合成水ρ1000 kg/m³，Q0.020 m³/s，H20 m，軸功率5.0 kW，電力5.5 kW。 Ph=1000×9.81×0.020×20=3924 W；泵η78.48%，泵組η71.345%。
矩形懸臂I=bt³/12，端點小撓度δ=FL³/(3EI)；此Euler–Bernoulli細長梁近似忽略剪變形，算例L/t=6的限制須記錄。L以三次方、t以負三次方影響撓度。 合成E=10 N/mm²、b=10 mm、t=5 mm、L=30 mm、F=0.2 N。 I=104.1667 mm⁴；δ=0.2×30³/(3×10×104.1667)=1.728 mm，δ/L=5.76%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Hydraulic power is ρ gQH; pump efficiency divides by shaft power, pump-set efficiency by electrical input. Synthetic water ρ1000 kg/m³, Q 0.020 m³/s, H 20 m, shaft 5.0 kW, electrical 5.5 kW. Ph=3924 W; pump η78.48%, pump-set η71.345%.

For a rectangular cantilever I=bt³/12 and small tip deflection δ=FL³/(3 EI). This Euler–Bernoulli slender-beam approximation omits shear deformation, a limitation at this example’s L/t=6; length and thickness enter cubically. Synthetic E 10 N/mm², b 10 mm, t 5 mm, L 30 mm, F 0.2 N. I=104.1667 mm⁴;δ=1.728 mm and δ/L=5.76%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
